question: The hardest substance in the human body is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. enamel of the tooth

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Tooth enamel is the hardest tissue in the body, containing a very high proportion of mineral

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — cartilage: Cartilage is flexible connective tissue and is much softer

C — the nail: Nails are made of keratin and are easily cut

D — compact bone: Compact bone is strong but softer than enamel

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Enamel does not regenerate, so patients who vomit repeatedly, as in bulimia, are advised to rinse the mouth with water instead of brushing at once

question: The chemical name of vitamin C is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. ascorbic acid

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Vitamin C is ascorbic acid, a water soluble vitamin that is easily destroyed by heat

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — oxalic acid: Oxalic acid is found in spinach and can reduce calcium absorption

B — citric acid: Citric acid gives lemons and oranges their sour taste but is not vitamin C

C — lactic acid: Lactic acid accumulates in muscle after vigorous exercise

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Vitamin C is lost in cooking water, so vegetables are steamed briefly and cut just before cooking

question: The normal pH of gastric juice is about:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 1.5 to 3.5

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Gastric juice is strongly acidic, with a pH of about 1.5 to 3.5 because of hydrochloric acid

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 4.5 to 5.5: This range is only mildly acidic

B — 6.5 to 7.5: This range is nearly neutral and does not describe gastric juice

C — 7.8 to 8.4: This range is alkaline and resembles pancreatic juice

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Because stomach contents are strongly acidic, a patient who vomits repeatedly loses hydrogen ions and can develop metabolic alkalosis

question: The enzyme in saliva that begins the digestion of starch is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. salivary amylase

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Salivary amylase, also called ptyalin, starts the breakdown of starch into simpler sugars in the mouth

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — lipase: Lipase digests fats and acts mainly in the small intestine

C — pepsin: Pepsin acts on proteins in the stomach

D — trypsin: Trypsin acts on proteins in the small intestine

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: This is why a patient is asked to chew food well, as digestion of starch begins in the mouth itself

question: Body temperature, hunger and thirst are regulated by the:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. hypothalamus

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The hypothalamus is the control centre for temperature, hunger, thirst and many autonomic functions

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — pituitary gland: The pituitary gland secretes hormones that control other glands

B — thyroid gland: The thyroid gland controls the rate of metabolism

C — adrenal gland: The adrenal gland secretes cortisol and adrenaline

⚠️ Exam Trap: Know the definition AND the unit - exams love near-sounding concepts.

💎 PNC Pearl: Hypothalamic control is the reason a patient with a high fever loses appetite and feels thirsty, and both must be attended to

question: Colour blindness is inherited as a:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. sex linked recessive trait

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The gene lies on the X chromosome, so a male who inherits one affected X is colour blind while a woman must inherit two affected X chromosomes to be affected

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — autosomal recessive trait: An autosomal recessive trait would lie on an autosome and would affect both sexes equally

C — Y linked trait: A Y linked trait passes only from father to son

D — autosomal dominant trait: An autosomal dominant trait affects males and females equally in every generation

⚠️ Exam Trap: For genetic questions work out the pattern of inheritance before the probability.

💎 PNC Pearl: The mother of an affected boy is usually a carrier, so genetic counselling is offered to the family

question: The type of immunity that a newborn receives through breast milk is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. passive natural immunity

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Antibodies passed to the baby in colostrum and milk give ready made protection without the baby producing them, which is natural passive immunity

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — passive artificial immunity: Passive artificial immunity follows injection of immune globulin

B — active natural immunity: Active natural immunity follows an infection that the person recovers from

C — active artificial immunity: Active artificial immunity follows vaccination

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: Colostrum is rich in immunoglobulin A, which protects the gut, so it must never be discarded

question: When zinc granules are added to dilute hydrochloric acid, the gas evolved is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. hydrogen

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Zinc displaces hydrogen from the acid, so hydrogen gas is released with brisk effervescence

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — oxygen: Oxygen is not liberated when a metal reacts with a dilute acid

C — chlorine: Chlorine is not produced by this reaction

D — carbon dioxide: Carbon dioxide is released when a carbonate reacts with an acid

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: The same reaction is used in the laboratory test for hydrogen, where the escaping gas burns with a pop sound

question: What is 25 percent of 240?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 60

🧠 Method: A quarter of 240 is 60, so 25 percent of 240 is 60

⚡ Fast Approach: Break the percentage into easy parts (10 percent, 5 percent, 1 percent) and add them.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 48: 48 is 20 percent of 240

C — 55: 55 is not a simple fraction of 240

D — 72: 72 is 30 percent of 240

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Working out a quarter or a tenth mentally is a quick way to check a dose or a dilution before it is given

question: The highest common factor of 24 and 36 is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 12

🧠 Method: The factors common to both numbers are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12, so the highest is 12

⚡ Fast Approach: Substitute into the standard formula and keep the units consistent.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 6: 6 is a common factor but not the highest

C — 72: 72 is the lowest common multiple of the two numbers

D — 4: 4 divides both numbers but is not the highest common factor

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Simplifying a ratio by its highest common factor gives the smallest whole numbers, which is how a solution strength is expressed simply

question: The area of a triangle with a base of 12 centimetres and a height of 5 centimetres is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 30 square centimetres

🧠 Method: The area of a triangle is half the base multiplied by the height, so half of 12 multiplied by 5 gives 30 square centimetres

⚡ Fast Approach: Substitute into the standard formula and keep the units consistent.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 17 square centimetres: 17 is the sum of the base and the height

C — 15 square centimetres: 15 is a quarter of the correct area

D — 60 square centimetres: 60 square centimetres is the product without halving

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Working out surface area is essential when estimating the dressing material needed for a wound

question: The compound interest on 1000 rupees at 10 percent per annum for 2 years is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 210 rupees

🧠 Method: The amount after two years is 1000 multiplied by 1.1 twice, which is 1210 rupees, so the compound interest is 210 rupees

⚡ Fast Approach: Substitute into the standard formula and keep the units consistent.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 220 rupees: 220 rupees would require a higher rate

B — 200 rupees: 200 rupees is the simple interest for the same period

C — 121 rupees: 121 rupees is only the interest for the second year

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Compound interest explains why a small recurring deposit grows faster over the years than a simple savings account

question: One pipe fills a tank in 6 hours and another fills the same tank in 12 hours. Working together, they will fill the tank in:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 4 hours

🧠 Method: In one hour the pipes fill one sixth plus one twelfth, which is one quarter of the tank, so the whole tank takes 4 hours

⚡ Fast Approach: Combine rates as 1/A + 1/B, then invert to get the number of days.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 18 hours: 18 hours is the sum of the two times

B — 3 hours: 3 hours would need both pipes together to be faster than the given rates allow

C — 9 hours: 9 hours is the average of 6 and 12 and ignores the combined rate

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: The same rate reasoning is used to plan how many staff are needed to complete a set of tasks within a shift

question: A boat covers 12 kilometres downstream in one hour and the same distance upstream in two hours. The speed of the stream is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 3 kilometres per hour

🧠 Method: The downstream speed is 12 and the upstream speed is 6, so the speed of the stream is half the difference, which is 3 kilometres per hour

⚡ Fast Approach: Substitute into the standard formula and keep the units consistent.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 1.5 kilometres per hour: 1.5 is a quarter of the difference

C — 6 kilometres per hour: 6 is the upstream speed itself

D — 9 kilometres per hour: 9 is the speed of the boat in still water

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: The same idea of relative speeds applies when a patient is transported by boat or ambulance across water and land

question: The average of five numbers is 20. If one of them, 24, is removed, the average of the remaining four numbers is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 19

🧠 Method: The total of the five numbers is 100, and after removing 24 the total is 76, which divided by four gives 19

⚡ Fast Approach: Total = average x number of items. Find the total first, then subtract the known values.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 18: 18 would need the total of the rest to be 72

B — 21: 21 is higher than the original average, which is impossible after removing a number above the average

C — 20: 20 is the original average and is not retained after a larger number is removed

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: The same reasoning explains why removing the highest value from a set of observations lowers the mean

question: Which is the odd one out: 2, 3, 5, 7, 9?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 9

🧠 Method: All the others are prime numbers, while 9 is divisible by 3 and is therefore composite

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the circles of the given sets and see which conclusion is certain.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 7: 7 is a prime number

B — 5: 5 is a prime number

C — 3: 3 is a prime number

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: The habit of checking each item against a rule helps in spotting a wrongly labelled specimen among a batch

question: Pointing to a photograph, a man says, "She is the daughter of my father's only son." How is the girl related to him?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. his daughter

🧠 Method: His father's only son is the man himself, so the girl is his own daughter

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the family tree and mark the given relations before answering.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — his niece: A niece would be the daughter of his brother or sister

C — his cousin: A cousin would be the child of his uncle or aunt

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Drawing a simple family tree during history taking prevents mistakes in recording consanguinity, which matters in genetic counselling

question: The angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 3 o'clock is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 90 degrees

🧠 Method: The hour hand is on 3 and the minute hand is on 12, which are three hours apart, and each hour is 30 degrees, giving 90 degrees

⚡ Fast Approach: Use the remainder after dividing by 7 for days, and 30 degrees per hour for clocks.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 120 degrees: 120 degrees is four hour spaces

C — 45 degrees: 45 degrees is one and a half hour spaces

D — 60 degrees: 60 degrees is the separation of only two hour spaces

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Reading a clock accurately is important when recording the exact time of drug administration and of the onset of symptoms

question: If today is Monday, what day of the week will it be after 45 days?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. Thursday

🧠 Method: Dividing 45 by 7 leaves a remainder of 3, and three days after Monday is Thursday

⚡ Fast Approach: Use the remainder after dividing by 7 for days, and 30 degrees per hour for clocks.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Tuesday: Tuesday is one day after Monday

question: In a certain code, MOTHER is written as NPUIFS. How is FATHER written in the same code?
solution:

🧠 Method: Each letter is moved one place forward in the alphabet, so F becomes G, A becomes B, T becomes U, H becomes I, E becomes F and R becomes S

question: In a class of 40 students, 25 play cricket and 20 play football, and 10 play both games. How many students play neither game?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. 5

🧠 Method: The number playing at least one game is 25 plus 20 minus 10, which is 35, so 40 minus 35 leaves 5 students who play neither

⚡ Fast Approach: Substitute into the standard formula and keep the units consistent.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — 15: 15 is the number who play football only

C — 10: 10 is the number playing both games

D — 35: 35 is the number who play at least one game
